sections.content: Surface codes encode one logical qubit into many physical qubits so local errors can be detected via stabilizers and corrected. Distance sets how many errors can be fixed.

sections.description: Distance-3 surface code inject and correct
sections.code:
import os, sys
_LQE = os.environ.get("LQE_PATH", os.path.abspath(os.path.join("..", "legitimate_quantum_engine_v5.0")))
_ECO = os.environ.get("LQE_ECOSYSTEM_PATH", os.path.abspath(".."))
for _p in (_LQE, _ECO):
    if _p not in sys.path:
        sys.path.insert(0, _p)
from legitimate_quantum_engine.quantum_error_correction.surface_code import SurfaceCode
sc = SurfaceCode(distance=3)
sc.encode_logical_zero()
sc.inject_error('X', 0)
print('Syndrome:', sc.measure_syndrome())
sc.decode_mwpm(); sc.correct()
print('Logical:', sc.measure_logical())
